reason: Read web/src/kit/data/cursor-list.ts and its test. Page size validation (lines 58-61), default 50 (line 4), listener isolation in commit (lines 69-78) and getState returning the single snapshot variable (lines 162-164) satisfy every THEN clause. The test asserts all clauses except the getState identity one, which the code settles trivially and cannot be added to a frozen test by a fix. No document forbids the sign-up listener call.

Every change calls every listener and a throwing listener does not stop the others, so the second subscriber is called for every change.
getState returns the same snapshot object until commit reassigns it, so two reads without a change are one object.
